name: capability
description: Capability frame. OPTIONAL, zero or more. Declares a named extension a writer relied on. See spec/sbtrace-v1.md §6.2.

fields.name: mandatory
fields.description: If true, a reader that does not implement 'name' MUST reject the trace. If false, advisory.

fields.name: params
fields.description: Extension-specific parameters. Opaque to the v1 spec.

extension_ranges.description: Allocated by registered capability frames. A capability may use this range to namespace its own per-frame metadata, but the metadata sits inside 'params', not at the top level.
Vendor-private. Readers MUST ignore unknown experimental capability fields.
